page.overview:
Who is Havadisa Argosaz?

Havadisa Argosaz was a representative of House Argosaz in the Landsraad.

Havadisa Argosaz was approached by the Prisoner outside the Griffin's Reach Tradepost in the southern Hagga Basin.
